records.title: Swift shared ledger: one row, four readings
kv: SWIFT announces it will add a blockchain-based shared ledger to its core infrastructure with thirty-plus global banks — 24/7 tokenized-deposit cross-border payments. The rail that cut Russia off in 2022 rebuilds itself in the challengers' image. Incumbents don't die; they absorb. · Study headline: SWIFT's blockchain ledger is moving real money
Status: controlled initial use preparing · Limit: No completed Japanese production transaction or disclosed yen loss rule existed at cutoff.
Status: MVP ready; pilots pending · Maturity grade: M4 · authorised or production-bound · Next record to look for: First completed pilot, exact cash leg, finality, liquidity and correction evidence.
October 19, 2026 · Swift ledger page (crypto and networks master)

Swift lists 17 banks; 6 bank-published pilot transactions, published August 19, 2026 to September 7, 2026. Status: Real money has moved in bank-reported controlled transactions, but banks call them 'live pilots' or a 'controlled proof of concept' and Swift calls this an 'initial controlled go-live phase'. No general availability date. · What the page shows: the focused page (Oct 19, 2026) lists 17 banks and 6 bank-published pilot transactions · Note: S080 card: six bank-published pilot transactions dated Aug 19 - Sep 7, 2026 on the focused page.

records.title: Pan unveils the Hong Kong package: Southbound Bond Connect quota to 800 billion yuan, a central clearing system for gold with a Shanghai delivery connect, the RMB facility to 500 billion …
records.text: Pan unveils the Hong Kong package: Southbound Bond Connect quota to 800 billion yuan, a central clearing system for gold with a Shanghai delivery connect, the RMB facility to 500 billion, and a pledge to shift FX-reserve investment into Hong Kong assets. Gold clearing, yuan liquidity and reserve money, all routed through the one Chinese city the dollar system still recognizes.

records.text: Bolivia ends the 6.96 peg held since 2011 and floats the boliviano — opening near 9.73 to the dollar, a 40% devaluation by market. Fifteen years of fixed money end in one resolution. The country that pays for fuel in Tether now lets the market name its currency's price.
